meta.name: Batashey Gungun
meta.description: Love, obsession, and deception collide when Pallabi’s desire for Arindam, her married professor, spirals out of control. As her obsession deepens, Arindam fights to save his marriage to Mithila. But when emotions turn explosive, no one escapes the storm unharmed.

videos.title: Ek Je Chhilo Meye
videos.overview: Pallabi falls for her married professor, and their growing closeness pushes them dangerously close to the edge.
